description: Recompute a cross-border B2B payment's true all-in cost in three independent stages: itemize the invoice's cost stack (FX spread, method fee, VAT/reverse-charge, documentary-credit, reconciliation) as a percentage of invoice value (ART-367), recompute the corridor's declared cost gap against the hardcoded G20/FSB roadmap targets for the declared year (ART-549), then model the same corridor on a USDC stablecoin rail to show the cheaper alternative (ART-250), closing with a session receipt aggregating the run's execution hashes (CRY-05). Every figure is caller-declared; no live FX or rate calls. Not FX advice.
name: cross-border-payment-cost-check
regulatory_refs: G20/FSB cross-border payments roadmap cost targets (transparency benchmarks, not enforceable deadlines)

steps.handoff: Itemizes the caller's cross-border B2B invoice cost stack: FX spread cost, method/correspondent fee, VAT or reverse-charge cost, documentary-credit cost, and reconciliation cost, plus total cost as a percentage of invoice value
Recomputes the caller-declared corridor cost gap in basis points against the hardcoded G20/FSB target for the declared year, with a meets_target verdict

Models the all-in cost of the same corridor on a USDC stablecoin rail (on-ramp, chain fee, off-ramp, FX spread, float savings) against the traditional correspondent benchmark, with break-even send amount
Produces session_receipt_root, the Merkle root over the run's execution_hashes (final stage)

title: Cross-Border Payment Cost Check
